SELECT
  l.id, l.email, l.first_name, l.last_name, l.full_name,
  l.title, l.company, l.phone, l.icp_tier AS tier,
  l.score, l.status, l.sequence_id,
  lb.brief,
  c.website, c.industry, c.employee_count
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs lb ON lb.lead_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN companies  c  ON c.id = l.company_id
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT cc.config
FROM client_configs cc
JOIN leads l ON l.client_id = cc.client_id
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO meetings (
  lead_id, sequence_id,
  status, calendly_event_type,
  slots_offered, scheduling_link,
  proposal_subject, proposal_body,
  proposal_sent_at, followup_due_at,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2,
  'proposed', $3,
  $4::jsonb, $5,
  $6, $7,
  NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id AS meeting_id;

UPDATE leads
SET status = 'meeting_proposed', stage = 'meeting_proposed',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('meeting_proposed', $1, $2::jsonb, NOW());

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'meeting.proposed',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id AS lead_id, l.email, l.first_name, l.full_name, l.company,
  l.icp_tier AS tier, l.sequence_id,
  m.id AS meeting_id, m.status AS meeting_status,
  m.proposal_sent_at, m.slots_offered
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN meetings m ON m.lead_id = l.id AND m.status = 'proposed'
WHERE l.email = $1
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE meetings
SET
  status          = 'booked',
  calendly_event_uri = $2,
  scheduled_at    = $3::timestamptz,
  booked_at       = NOW(),
  updated_at      = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id AS meeting_id, lead_id, scheduled_at;

UPDATE leads
SET status = 'meeting_booked', stage = 'meeting_booked',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'meeting.booked',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'meeting.canceled',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
);

SELECT
  m.id AS meeting_id,
  m.lead_id,
  m.proposal_sent_at,
  m.followup_sent,
  m.scheduling_link,
  m.slots_offered,
  l.email, l.first_name, l.full_name, l.company,
  l.icp_tier AS tier, l.sequence_id
FROM meetings m
JOIN leads l ON l.id = m.lead_id
WHERE m.status = 'proposed'
  AND m.followup_sent = FALSE
  AND m.proposal_sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'
  AND l.status != 'unsubscribed'
  AND l.do_not_contact = FALSE
LIMIT 20;
